message:
Last weekend, I gathered the grandkids to talk about our family emergency plan. I thought it would be a serious chat, but of course, they turned it into a game of ‘what if.’ What if the house turned into a spaceship? What if we had to escape from a giant marshmallow? I found myself laughing more than I expected, but it reminded me how important it is to keep things light while still preparing for the unexpected. 

In the end, we did get around to packing our go-bags, and they were delighted to add their favorite snacks. Sometimes, it’s not just about being ready; it’s about building memories together. How do you involve your kids in your family plans?
